projects.title: Graduation Project - IS 2026
projects.description: Undergraduate capstone project (CCSIT, King Faisal University). 360° soft-skills assessment per milestone.

competencies.description: Clarity, frequency and effectiveness in exchanging information with the team.

rubric.1: Rarely shares information; messages are unclear or missing.
rubric.2: Shares information when asked; clarity is inconsistent.
rubric.3: Communicates adequately in meetings and channels.
rubric.4: Communicates clearly and proactively; listens actively.
rubric.5: Exemplary: keeps everyone aligned, adapts message to audience, listens and confirms understanding.

competencies.description: Guiding colleagues, being proactive and helping resolve conflicts.

rubric.1: Does not take initiative; avoids responsibility.
rubric.2: Takes initiative occasionally or tends to control rather than guide.
rubric.3: Leads tasks when needed and supports decisions.
rubric.4: Takes initiative, delegates fairly and motivates others.
rubric.5: Empowers the team, delegates effectively and resolves conflicts constructively.

competencies.description: Resilience and flexibility to changing requirements, critical feedback or unexpected challenges.

rubric.1: Resists change and reacts defensively to feedback.
rubric.2: Accepts change slowly; struggles with critical feedback.
rubric.3: Adjusts to change with some support.
rubric.4: Adapts quickly and uses feedback to improve.
rubric.5: Thrives on change, seeks feedback and helps others adapt.

competencies.description: Teamwork, fair contribution and a positive, inclusive group dynamic.

rubric.1: Works in isolation; contribution is minimal.
rubric.2: Contributes unevenly; limited support for teammates.
rubric.3: Contributes a fair share and cooperates.
rubric.4: Actively supports teammates and shares workload.
rubric.5: Builds an inclusive team culture and lifts everyone's work.

competencies.description: Recognizing challenges, critical thinking and producing effective solutions.

rubric.1: Struggles to identify problems; depends on others for solutions.
rubric.2: Identifies problems but solutions are incomplete.
rubric.4: Analyzes problems well and proposes effective solutions.
rubric.5: Solves complex problems creatively and anticipates issues.

reports.narrative:
Khalid, this report combines your self-assessment, the anonymous evaluations of 3 teammates and your instructor's evaluation. Your overall self-rating is 4.4/5 while the weighted external score (60% instructor, 40% peers) is 3.6/5.

The largest perception gap is in Leadership: you rated yourself 5, but others rated you 2.9 (delta 2.1). In Johari Window terms this is a potential blind spot - a behavior visible to your team and instructor that you may not be fully aware of.

Peer comments related to Leadership include observations such as: "Khalid takes over tasks without asking the team."

Your self-perception is well aligned with how others see you across all five skills.
One teammate wrote: "Fahad shares the workload fairly with the team."
actionable_steps: Send a short written update to your team after each work session (what you did, what is next, blockers).
Summarize decisions at the end of every meeting and confirm everyone understood them.
Practice active listening: paraphrase a teammate's point before responding.

paragraphs: Omar, this report combines your self-assessment, the anonymous evaluations of 3 teammates and your instructor's evaluation. Your overall self-rating is 4.2/5 while the weighted external score (60% instructor, 40% peers) is 3.8/5.

actionable_steps: Delegate at least two meaningful tasks in the next sprint and agree on the expected outcome.

Request direct feedback on your coordination style halfway through the next evaluation period.
